fees.label: Commercial building permit — 2026 valuation table
fees.citation_note: 2026 Building Code Enforcement permit fee schedule. Commercial building permit follows the valuation table. Plan review is 25% of the estimated building permit fee and is non-refundable. A minimum permit fee and an administrative fee are separate lines. This page does not state a permit total. Pasadena, Sugar Land, and The Woodlands are different schedules.

gotchas.title: City of Houston is not the metro
checklist: Do not use this table for Pasadena, Sugar Land, or The Woodlands
anti_patterns: Bidding a suburb on the City of Houston valuation table
